item_name: Rothco MOLLE Universal Double Rifle Mag Pouch
item_short_desc: Rothco’s MOLLE Universal Double Rifle Mag Pouch is a versatile and durable solution for securely carrying rifle magazines during tactical operations, shooting range sessions, or outdoor adventures. Designed to hold up to 4 M-16 or AK-47 mags, this pouch is equipped with reliable hook and loop closures and elastic straps to ensure your magazines stay securely in place, while still allowing for quick and easy reloads.
description: Rothco’s MOLLE Universal Double Rifle Mag Pouch is a versatile and durable solution for securely carrying rifle magazines during tactical operations, shooting range sessions, or outdoor adventures. Designed to hold up to 4 M-16 or AK-47 mags, this pouch is equipped with reliable hook and loop closures and elastic straps to ensure your magazines stay securely in place, while still allowing for quick and easy reloads. The MOLLE-compatible design allows you to attach the mag pouch to tactical vests, range bags, or any gear featuring MOLLE webbing, giving you flexible customization options. Constructed with heavy-duty materials, this pouch is built for rugged environments and long-lasting performance. Grommet drain holes at the bottom of each pouch prevent moisture buildup, ensuring your magazines stay dry and protected. Measuring 7 ½ inches by 8 inches, Rothco’s double mag pouch offers the perfect balance of convenience, security, and durability for any tactical professional, shooting enthusiast, or MilSim player.
